verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair capability to ask of a cloud file-storage product, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions any AI assistant or task delegation inside OneDrive. The cited docs cover only file access, sharing, sync, versioning and Graph API primitives, none of which constitute an in-product assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
